windows.title: Amanuensis — Local AI Translation Workbench & Scanned PDF Suite

bundle.shortDescription: Next-gen CAT tool with Auxiliary TMs, Local GGUF Project Harness, and Scanned PDF OCR Suite
bundle.longDescription: Amanuensis is a cross-platform translation workbench for Linux, macOS, and Windows featuring hybrid SQLite FTS5 + Vector Translation Memories, project-scoped AGENT.md + skills harnesses for small local models, and a scanned PDF to Searchable PDF & Markdown conversion suite.
